config_coupling.effect: Without a nonempty CLI database override, the database path is XDG_DATA_HOME/concord/concord.db when XDG_DATA_HOME is nonempty, otherwise HOME/.local/share/concord/concord.db. Resolution refuses when neither data home nor user home is available; database admission remains a separate check.
config_coupling.source: Process environment XDG_DATA_HOME, falling back to os.UserHomeDir when unset or empty; the CLI calls this resolver only when CONCORD_DB_PATH is empty.
